text: Nice try, Ben. I saw that bluff from across the room.

text: Raising to 1,250. That's 3.5 times the big blind, and the pot is $4,800.

label: names
text: Siobhan, Nguyen and Marguerite all folded, so it's down to Xavier and me.

label: worried thought
text: That's a big bet. Please don't have the ace.

label: sad bust-out
text: Well, that's all my chips gone. It was a fun game, though.

label: angry fold
text: Fold. And I'm not happy about it, not even a little.

label: question
text: Wait, you had a flush the whole time? Why on earth did you check?

label: long story
text: I once folded a full house because I thought the dealer had misdealt, and I'm still not sure whether I was right. Anyway, it taught me to count the cards, then count them again, and never to trust a man who smiles that much.
